reason: In our house the clothes have always been washed by hand and it gets done; I have never felt we needed a machine. If I ever did buy one, I would start with an ordinary semi-automatic for half this money, not pay extra for a battery.
objection: A normal semi-automatic costs about half of ₹21,999, and we do not even own a washer yet, so paying double for battery backup feels like paying for a problem we do not have.
would_change_my_mind: If a neighbour's family I trust used it for a few months and I saw it really save the women of the house their daily hours, even through the power cuts, at a price closer to a normal semi-automatic.
